title: ModRisk-MultiNet: frequency-audited MVMR and corrected multimorbidity network outputs
description: Versioned project-authored code and derived, non-restricted outputs for a 71-disease multimorbidity genetic-correlation network. Version 1.0.3 is a licence-only patch that applies CC BY 4.0 to project-authored code, documentation and derived outputs; scientific code, data and results are unchanged from v1.0.2. Manuscripts and restricted third-party GWAS files are not redistributed.
